description: This file defines a PHP class 'ADODB2_mysql' that extends 'ADODB_DataDict' and provides methods and properties for MySQL database schema management within the ADOdb database abstraction layer. It includes functions for type mapping, SQL generation for indexes, and table/column alterations.

classes.name: ADODB2_mysql
classes.description: A class for MySQL-specific database schema operations within the ADOdb PHP library.

methods.name: metaType
methods.description: Maps PHP data types to ADOdb internal type codes based on field properties.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Returns the actual SQL data type corresponding to an internal meta type code.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Generates SQL suffix string for column definitions based on attributes like nullability, default, auto-increment, etc.

methods.name: _IndexSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements for creating or dropping indexes on tables.
